newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish NFI Hetman Q1 1997 net rises to PLN 0.7 mln.
newsitem.headline: Polish NFI Hetman Q1 1997 net rises to PLN 0.7 mln.

text.p: National Investment Fund Hetman (No 15) in Poland's mass privatisation scheme lifted 1997 first quarter net profit to 0.7 million zlotys from 0.3 million in the same period last year, the fund said in a statement on Friday.
In the whole of 1996 NFI Hetman made a net loss of 92.9 million zlotys.
NFI Hetman said its net assets rose to 401.3 million zlotys in this year's first quarter from 322.4 million in the same period last year.
Under the government's NFI programme, shares in about 500 mid-sized companies are allocated to 15 NFIs run by foreign and domestic management firms.

From May 12, the 26 million Poles who bought a participation unit in the scheme will be entitled to exchange it for 15 shares, one in each fund, which are expected to start trade on the Warsaw bourse around mid-year.
The units lose their validity on December 31, 1998.
